mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies with a temperature of 72 degrees and a Waxing Crescent moon above the Military Ridge State Trail.

The Verona Senior Center is inviting community members to volunteer for programs. You would need to commit to two sessions per month, and please keep in mind that some roles involve physical tasks like lifting or climbing stairs. The center emphasizes maintaining participant confidentiality at all times.

Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or head to the Verona Ice Arena for the Girls Try Hockey event. Tomorrow, check out the User Group Meeting at Epic or yoga at Insight Wellness.

In a report covering the week of August 3 to August 10, police responded to several calls. Notably, on Wednesday, August 6, a 49-year-old driver was arrested for a fourth O W I offence after being spotted driving erratically.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. The store is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM. If you are planning ahead for tomorrow, the flavor will be Caramel Peanut Buttercup.
